meaning:
παράσημος, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark) [in LXX: 3Ma.2:29 * ;]
1. in cl., marked amiss, spurious, counterfeit. Later,
2. marked at the side, annotated (Plut.).
3. marked with a sign (LXX); as subst., a figure­head : Act.28:11 (see MM, xix).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose sign was “The Twin Brothers.”
